title: Drishyam 3 Box Office: Film jumps to Rs 5 cr on day 16; worldwide gross hits Rs 528.77 cr
description: Ajay Devgn's 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' saw a 61.3% increase in box office collections on its third Saturday. The movie earned Rs 5 crore on Day 16, improving its cumulative domestic net collection to Rs 341.10 crore. Its worldwide gross collection reached Rs 528.77 crore, with domestic and overseas contributions. The film, which continues the story from its predecessor, features an ensemble cast including Tabu and Shriya Saran.

title: 'Nayyi Navelli' box office collection day 2: Yami Gautam's film earns Rs 4 cr
description: Yami Gautam's latest film, 'Nayyi Navelli,' has shown promising performance at the box office, raking in Rs 4 crore on its second day, pushing its two-day domestic total to Rs 7.25 crore. The film, which successfully blends comedy, horror, and mythology, has seen a rise in audience interest, particularly for evening screenings. Although a cancellation in Noida impacted its debut, it appears to be gaining traction as viewers respond positively.

title: 'Ranabaali' BO day 2
description: In a remarkable performance, Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna's film 'Ranabaali' secured Rs 7.30 crore on its second day. The film's domestic net total now stands at Rs 16.55 crore from its opening day earnings, with audience attendance reaching 551,946. Director Sandeep Reddy Vanga commended the actors and the film's historical context, encouraging viewers to experience this powerful story about the resistance during the Madras Famine of 1876-1878.

title: ‘Verity’ loses 500 theatre screens with third weekend due to box office decline
description: After its third weekend, Verity has suffered a notable decline in box office earnings, losing more than 500 screens in North America due to falling viewership. Its revenue plummeted from USD 32 million in the debut weekend to just USD 12 million the following weekend. Despite this, the film has grossed USD 119 million globally, surpassing its production budget, yet continues to face major challenges in maintaining box office momentum.

title: 'Jailer 2' BO day 3: Rajinikanth film crosses Rs 300 cr worldwide
description: 'Jailer 2', starring the iconic Rajinikanth, saw a remarkable increase in its box office performance on day three, grossing Rs 47.80 crore in India, a leap of 28.8% from the prior day. This brought the total net collection in India to an impressive Rs 144.60 crore. Overall, the worldwide collection reached Rs 317.15 crore, showcasing its extraordinary appeal.

title: Salman reveals his nana didn't speak to Salim Khan for 5 years after his parents' marriage
description: In a heartfelt reflection, Salman Khan shared insights into his parents' interfaith union and the initial objections raised by his maternal grandfather. He clarified that the concern was less about religion and more about the film industry's stigma. The family's estrangement ended with the arrival of Salman’s brother, Sohail Khan, paving the way for reconciliation.

title: When Akshay said Aarav doesn't want to tell anyone he's his son: 'He wants to carve his own identity'
description: Akshay Kumar once spoke about the impact which his father has had on his life and values. He expresses hope that his son, Aarav, will embrace these teachings as well. During a discussion, Akshay highlights his respect for military personnel, influenced by his father's army background. He also elaborates on the 'Bharat Ke Veer' initiative, which supports families of martyred soldiers.

title: Archana, Parmeet's son Aaryamann recalls being bullied in UK during football training
description: Originally aiming for a career in football, Aaryamann Sethi faced a tough turn of events when injuries struck during his training in England. Battling feelings of isolation and bullying in boarding school, he suffered two serious leg fractures that ended his aspirations. With encouragement from his family, he pivoted to creative outlets, now expressing his story through his YouTube channel, Aary Vlogs, alongside pursuits in music and acting.

title: When Raj spoke about falling in love with Smita despite being married to Nadira
description: Raj Babbar was initially married to Nadira Zaheer and had two children with her. He later fell in love with actress Smita Patil, leading to considerable controversy around their relationship. After getting married in 1983, they welcomed their son Prateik, but their happiness was short-lived. Smita passed away shortly after childbirth, leaving a profound impact on Raj and the film industry.

title: Imran Khan seeks urgent stay on notice to leave India, moves to Bombay High Court
description: In a poignant legal move, actor Imran Khan has filed a petition with the Bombay High Court against an issued removal notice, arguing it was served without a fair hearing, violating his rights. As an Overseas Citizen of India who has lived in India since age two, Khan contends he faced wrongful detention during a protest in Mumbai, seeking to annul the notice due to its vague claims.

title: Saif proposed to Kareena in Paris, Greece: 'That's when I said yes'

Kareena divulged that Saif popped the question thrice in iconic locations like Mumbai, Greece, and Paris before she finally accepted. They married in 2012. On this special occasion, Kareena shared cherished memories via social media.

title: Ektaa recalls discovering hate groups targeting her and Aishwarya, says there's Hinduphobia among people

She reflected on being mocked for wearing traditional religious symbols and the judgment related to her faith. Ekta also expressed concern about the perceived Hinduphobia surrounding Indian folklore and mythology in contemporary media. She emphasized the importance of accepting and discussing these cultural narratives.
